title: admet-screening: auditable source-level admission for multi-source ADMET aggregation
description:
Research code accompanying the manuscript Source-level admission in multi-source ADMET aggregation is a cost-conditional decision.

The deposit contains the five-strategy prediction pipeline, the frozen preregistration package, the per-seed result records for five TDC endpoints (hERG, DILI, BBB_Martins, Ames, CYP3A4_Veith), the four cost-dependent tables, and the closed-form critical-cost estimator c* = Delta-u(0) / (cov_S1 - cov_S4).

Verification does not require retraining: ./reproduce.sh regenerates Tables 1, 2b, 2c and 3 from the deposited per-seed records in under a minute and checks each output against deposit/EXPECTED_SHA256.json. Those CSVs are a pure function of the deposited inputs, so the check is bit-exact. ./reproduce.sh --full additionally retrains all five endpoints (about 1.5 hours on 8 cores); retraining is reproducible to tolerance rather than bit for bit.

Third-party datasets (TDC ADMET_Group splits) and the OneADMET supporting information are not redistributed, in keeping with their licences and size; their identities and SHA-256 values are recorded so that independently obtained copies can be verified.
notes: Creators list is set to the contributor group at deposit time; replace with individual names and ORCIDs on the Zenodo record before publishing the DOI, then mirror the change in CITATION.cff.
